nodes.title: SG-7.2 · Extend the worker config with work root, budget, auto-publish and provider kind
nodes.body:
Context: backend/worker/internal/config/config.go already loads worker.world_id, repo_path, poll_interval, execution_timeout and max_retries with defaults and env overrides. Desired behavior: add the work root, maximum budget, auto-publish flag and provider kind, and validate these together with the existing timeout and max retries. Expected result: LoadFS returns a fully defaulted, validated Config or a field-naming error. Why: the execution engine needs these controls before it can run supervised, budgeted executions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a YAML with only worker.repo_path, when LoadFS runs, then WorkRoot, MaxBudget, AutoPublish and ProviderKind hold documented defaults
- Given an invalid timeout, retries, budget or provider kind, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a nil config and an error naming the field


## Scope
- In scope: backend/worker/internal/config/config.go
- In scope: backend/worker/configs/config.example.yaml
- Out of scope: Using the new fields in the runner or providers
- Out of scope: Backend and frontend config
- Preserve: Existing defaults for poll_interval, execution_timeout, max_retries, log and store
- Preserve: Existing repo_path validation and env overrides


## Technical constraints
- Go, gopkg.in/yaml.v3, no new dependencies
- Auto-publish default false (supervised publishing)


## Definition of done
- Config fields, defaults and validation implemented
- Example YAML documents the new keys


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Worker config exposes work root, max budget, auto-publish and provider kind with defaults
nodes.body:
Context: WorkerConfig has no fields for work root, budget, publish mode or provider. Desired behavior: add WorkRoot (work_root), MaxBudget (max_budget, float USD), AutoPublish (auto_publish) and ProviderKind (provider_kind) and default them in LoadFS. Expected result: omitted keys yield work_root .storyforge/work, max_budget 5, auto_publish false, provider_kind mock. Why: safe supervised defaults.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given YAML omitting the new keys, when LoadFS runs, then WorkRoot is .storyforge/work, MaxBudget is 5, AutoPublish is false and ProviderKind is mock
- Given YAML setting work_root, max_budget, auto_publish true and provider_kind claude, when LoadFS runs, then those values are returned unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: WorkerConfig fields
- In scope: defaults in LoadFS
- In scope: config.example.yaml keys
- Out of scope: Validation of values
- Preserve: Existing fields and defaults


## Technical constraints
- Mirror the existing default-constant pattern


## Definition of done
- Fields and defaults present
- Example YAML updated


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Worker config validation rejects invalid execution settings with field-naming errors
nodes.body:
Context: LoadFS validates only repo_path. Desired behavior: after defaults, reject negative execution_timeout, negative max_retries, negative max_budget and a provider_kind other than mock or claude. Expected result: error text contains the YAML key name and config is nil. Why: fail fast on a misconfigured worker.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given execution_timeout of -1m, max_retries of -1, max_budget of -1 or provider_kind of gpt, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a nil config and an error containing execution_timeout, max_retries, max_budget or provider_kind respectively
- Given provider_kind mock or claude with non-negative numbers, when LoadFS runs, then no error is returned


## Scope
- In scope: validate function called from LoadFS
- Out of scope: Validating repo_path existence on disk
- Preserve: repo_path empty error message


## Technical constraints
- Validation runs after defaults so zero values still default


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Invalid values rejected with key-naming errors


## Clarifying questions
- None
